association_evidence: Each gauge's provider name explicitly names the creek and crossing/park; provider coordinates locate it on the saved identically named OSM main channel. Geometry alone does not establish the creek identity.

geometry.meaning: A short stroke locates a gauge measurement along the named creek. Its length is a display symbol, not the length of measured or inferred flow. No downstream propagation or reach-wide discharge is asserted.
geometry.limits: Clip within one saved OSM way, at the 500 m cap on each side, and at any junction shared by saved ways. Unmapped tributaries are not resolved; that is another reason the stroke cannot represent reach-wide flow. Other stretches remain unmeasured.

views.label: Largest saved readings
views.meaning: Each gauge's maximum saved reading since the recorded storm start, through its own cutoff. These readings occurred at different times.

views.label: Oct 1 · 7 am
views.meaning: At or before 7 am Central on October 1, within 30 minutes; no interpolation.

views.label: Oct 2 · 7 am
views.meaning: At or before 7 am Central on October 2, within 30 minutes; no interpolation. Later maxima are outside this view.

display_scale.quantity: instantaneous discharge minus seasonal median daily discharge, cfs
display_scale.meaning: Discrete, capped symbolic line width and sequential color show absolute discharge contrast. Equal widths can hide different values within a band; exact values remain visible. Not inundation, physical channel width, flood severity, event rarity or a safety category.
